name: University of Engineering and Technology (UET), Lahore
_note: Merit: four official Fall 2025 'minimum aggregate' PDFs (UET hosts down with Cloudflare 522 on 31 Oct 2026, so each was fetched from its Wayback snapshot; source_url = original UET URL, archive_url = snapshot). Fourth Merit List 269 rows (portal: 'Minimum ADP Admission Aggregate (Fall-2025)' next to 'Fourth Merit list (Fall 2025) is live!'), walk-in 61, change of preference manual 71, online 192 (pivot table; afternoon section = A2/A2-M). Every row checked by script against the PDF text/word positions on 31 Oct 2026 (owner draft had 13 afternoon rows under Morning A1/A1-M and missed 2 rows; fixed). Category codes: Undergraduate Prospectus Spring 2026, pp. 21-24. Formula: same prospectus p. 19 (owner decision 31 Oct 2026); the portal 'Merit Calculation' image (20% test, 70% academics, 10% interview) matches the Spring 2025 interview-based admissions notice, not the Fall merit lists. Non-ECAT programs (BBA, BBIT, Interior Design, Biomedical Sciences) are excluded from the predictor. Re-check the live UET URLs when uet.edu.pk is back. Labels: list '4th list' = Fourth Merit List, 'Pref. change' = change of preference; category = UET code ('A1 open merit' = A1); campus 'Lahore (main)', 'KSK' (New Campus, Kala Shah Kaku), 'Faisalabad', 'RCET Gujranwala', 'Narowal'. Fall 2024 (Entry-2024): the portal page 'Minimum UG Admission Aggregate (Entry-2024)' (admission.uet.edu.pk/Downloads/MeritLists/Default.aspx), Wayback 14 Sep 2024 (151 rows; 1 row with the unexplained code 'T' left out) and 11 Feb 2025 (18 rows, A2/NM only); the page does not say which merit list it reflects, so list = 'Portal, <capture date>'. Checked by script against both captures on 1 Nov 2026. '(F.Sc. Based)' dropped from program names; 'Bio Medical Sciences' = Biomedical Sciences, 'Gaming and Animation' = Gaming and Animations.
